wearable_quality_bar: DAI must consume the same persisted session state as coach workflow, not a parallel mock.
Wearable data must change readiness context through explicit modifier language, not hidden personalization.
HealthKit and Health Connect must stay opt-in, source-traced, and permission-bound.
Permission-pending and unavailable snapshots must fail closed with zero readiness modifier and no wearable-derived training inference.
Local sample sync is allowed for deterministic tests; live device sync requires separate hardware proof.
Wearable copy must avoid diagnosis, body-pressure, or unsupported performance promises.

team_panel_proxy.boundary: No outreach, endorsement, public claim, or private wearable data export occurred.
